# Honorific Position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:HonorificPosition`](gmeow-HonorificPosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/HonorificPosition>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Whether an honorific is rendered before (prefix) or after (suffix) the name.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:HonorificPosition`](gmeow-HonorificPosition.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the closed-ish value vocabulary recording whether an honorific is rendered before (prefix) or after (suffix) the name — referenced from [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](../properties/gmeow-honorificPosition.md) on a [`gmeow:Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a [`Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md) subclass per position (positions are individuals) and avoid using it for anything but render placement — class/domain of the honorific is [`gmeow:HonorificClass`](gmeow-HonorificClass.md).

### How to use

- Reference [`gmeow:honorificPositionPrefix`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificPositionPrefix.md) or [`gmeow:honorificPositionSuffix`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificPositionSuffix.md) from [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](../properties/gmeow-honorificPosition.md) on a [`Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md) individual; the projection layer reads it to place the title around the name.

### Examples

- ex:honorific [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](../properties/gmeow-honorificPosition.md) [`gmeow:honorificPositionSuffix`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificPositionSuffix.md).
